name: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholders for text, blocks, avatars and compound content that preserve the loaded layout.

slots.name: Text
slots.signature: ({ type, lines, width, className, style, ...rest }: SkeletonTextProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of text or skeleton lines.

props.name: type
props.description: The type role being replaced (`type-*`); the skeleton takes exactly its line box.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the (last) line. Earlier lines of a multi-line block are full width.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

slots.name: Block
slots.signature: ({ width, height, radius, className, style, ...rest }: SkeletonBlockProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: height
props.description: Available height used for the component’s size tier.

props.name: radius
props.description: A radius role so the placeholder matches the thing it replaces.

props.name: width
props.description: Available width or named width tier.
